title: PullHire event envelope
description: Common envelope for every event on the pullhire.events topic exchange (docs/architecture.md §4.2).

event_id.description: Unique event id; consumers dedup on this value.

type.description: Event name / routing key, e.g. user.registered.

version.description: Envelope/payload version. Starts at 1; incremented only on an incompatible payload change.

occurred_at.description: UTC instant the event was produced (ISO-8601).

correlation_id.description: Chain id propagated from X-Request-Id for tracing.

payload.description: Event-specific body; validated by the per-event schema.
